evidence: Copper nitride thin films were formed by complementary, self-limiting reactions from copper(I) N,N′-di-sec-butylacetamidinate ([Cu( sBu-Me-amd)]2) with ammonia as the other reagent. The ALD equipment consists of a tube-furnace into which pulses of vapor were fed from a bubbler containing the copper precursor, into which measured doses of nitrogen carrier gas were metered.
